// note: Thresholds come from real Lighthouse runs, not guesses. Accessibility and best-practices measured 100 on the live site and a local production build; they are the defensible numbers for a recruiter-facing page, so they gate CI. SEO measured 92 only because Lighthouse's own robots.txt fetch times out under the WebGL scene's main-thread load (the file itself returns 200 and is valid) — kept as a warning so a flaky fetch never breaks the build.
// performance: Performance is asserted only on ?scene=off. A canvas that animates every frame never lets the main thread idle, so on the scene-on URLs TBT and TTI measure WebGL rather than this page and gating them would be meaningless. ?scene=off renders the same page a phone actually receives — the scene is withheld there and offered instead — so it is the honest thing to hold a budget against. Held at warn for its first run: the number below is a placeholder and gets replaced by the measured score before it becomes an error gate.
